integrity.claim_scope: Endpoint-integrability analysis of the invariant density printed in Lemma 4.1 and its use in the extinction threshold of Theorem 4.2.
integrity.evidence_basis: The published model, Lemma 4.1 density, Section 4 threshold, theorem statement, proof dependence on the invariant density, and numerical parameter examples were inspected; the endpoint calculation is analytic and replayable.

scientific_limitations: The result corrects the printed theorem domain. It does not classify the stochastic boundary process or epidemic dynamics when the missing condition fails, and it does not contradict the reported extinction examples, which satisfy the condition.
title: The SEI extinction threshold requires a missing boundary-noise integrability condition
